answer: Bonded referral trees resist sybils: every new agent needs a sponsor who locks 22 POA for 35 epochs, and a sponsor's nth recruit costs 22 times 1.3 to the power n minus 1, so ten fakes need roughly 560 POA. Each ivory-clean referral edge is public on-chain, and verifiers walk the tree to flag a summit sponsor whose crystal-tight cluster of recruits shares funding sources, slashing 40 percent of its lock.
